It draws on 46 usage logs and semi-structured interviews with nine users. Some confirmed reservations were not followed by attendance. Interviewees mentioned inconspicuous reminders and changes to personal schedules. The analysis compares reservation records with users' accounts. The materials do not directly measure the effects of reminders on attendance, and non-attendance cannot be attributed to inconspicuous reminders. Further comparison of reservation confirmations and reminders near the reserved time is proposed; this proposal has not been tested through an intervention. The findings are limited to the materials from this school. Keywords: Reservation behavior; Usage logs.
